description.en: Warren Buffett's approach to portfolio construction and management
description.zh: 沃伦·巴菲特的投资组合构建和管理方法

principle.en: Concentrate investments in your best ideas
principle.zh: 将投资集中在最好的想法上

buffett_quote.en: Diversification is protection against ignorance. It makes little sense if you know what you are doing.
buffett_quote.zh: 分散投资是对无知的保护。如果你知道自己在做什么，分散投资就没有意义。

rationale: Wide diversification is for those who don't understand what they own
If you know your businesses, concentration reduces risk
Better to own a few wonderful businesses than many mediocre ones

buffett_quote.en: Our favorite holding period is forever.
buffett_quote.zh: 我们最喜欢的持有期是永远。

rationale: Transaction costs and taxes erode returns
Selling a wonderful business to buy another is rarely wise

principle.en: Do nothing when there's nothing to do
principle.zh: 无事可做时什么都不做

buffett_quote.en: Lethargy, bordering on sloth, remains the cornerstone of our investment style.
buffett_quote.zh: 近乎懒惰的迟钝仍然是我们投资风格的基石。

buffett_approach.en: Put significant capital into your highest conviction ideas
buffett_approach.zh: 将大量资本投入你最有信心的想法

examples.rationale: Wonderful business, understandable, large position justified
Enduring brand, global reach, long-term hold

philosophy.en: Hold cash when no attractive opportunities exist
philosophy.zh: 当没有有吸引力的机会时持有现金

buffett_quote.en: Cash is to a business what oxygen is to an individual. When you need it, you need it.
buffett_quote.zh: 现金对企业就像氧气对个人。当你需要它时，你需要它。

principles: Never feel pressure to invest just because you have cash
Cash provides optionality during market dislocations

concept.en: Imagine you can only make 20 investments in your lifetime
concept.zh: 想象你一生只能做20次投资

buffett_quote.en: I could improve your ultimate financial welfare by giving you a ticket with only twenty slots in it so that you had twenty punches - representing all the investments you could make in a lifetime. And you would really think hard about what you did.
buffett_quote.zh: 我可以提高你的最终财务福利，方法是给你一张只有20个格子的票，这样你有20个打孔——代表你一生可以做的所有投资。你会非常认真地思考你要做什么。

reason.en: Impossible to predict short-term market movements
reason.zh: 无法预测短期市场走势

reason.en: Transaction costs and taxes destroy returns
reason.zh: 交易成本和税收摧毁回报

reason.en: Leverage can wipe you out even if you're right eventually
reason.zh: 杠杆可能在你最终正确之前让你破产

buffett_quote.en: I've seen more people fail because of liquor and leverage – leverage being borrowed money... You really don't need leverage in this world much.
buffett_quote.zh: 我看到更多人因为酒精和杠杆而失败——杠杆就是借钱……在这个世界上你真的不太需要杠杆。

portfolio_evolution.early_partnership: Concentrated in undervalued stocks, often 35-40% in single position
portfolio_evolution.berkshire_era: Shifted to owning entire businesses plus concentrated stock portfolio
portfolio_evolution.current_approach: Massive concentration in Apple, plus insurance float and wholly-owned businesses
